description: This file defines the data structures and methods for representing and manipulating nodes in an abstract syntax tree for Markdown parsing, including node types, tree traversal, and node management functions.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in the Markdown syntax tree, with properties for node type, parent, children, siblings, and associated data for specific node types.

methods.name: NewNode
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new Node of a specified type.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the node, including type and a snippet of its literal content.

methods.name: Unlink
methods.description: Removes the node from its current position in the tree.

methods.name: AppendChild
methods.description: Adds a child node to the current node.

methods.name: InsertBefore
methods.description: Inserts a sibling node immediately before the current node.

methods.name: IsContainer
methods.description: Checks if the node can contain child nodes based on its type.

methods.name: IsLeaf
methods.description: Checks if the node is a leaf node (has no children).

methods.name: canContain
methods.description: Determines if the node can contain a node of a specific type.

methods.name: Walk
methods.description: Traverses the subtree rooted at the node, invoking a visitor callback.
